summary: Added cycle detection to treeRows' visibleParent traversal, made navigateTree a required method on PiSessionLike, updated fixtures/tests accordingly, and adjusted CSS for tree scrolling and responsive tree-entry grid layout. Full app tests pass; prettier was fixed and re-run cleanly.
decisions: Cycle detection added to visibleParent in session-tree.ts via a 'seen' Set to avoid infinite loops when traversing ancestor chain.
navigateTree was made required on the PiSessionLike interface (was previously optional) so session-operations no longer branches on its presence and can always await it.
ScrollArea inside [data-ui='tree-screen'] gets min-width:0 / min-height:0 so flex children can shrink properly.
Tree-entry grid switches to 58px minmax(0,1fr) at smaller widths, with label/branch/here cells re-gridded to column 2.
Prettier auto-format was applied to session-tree.css to satisfy the formatting check.
errors: pnpm check failed: 'check-ui-hooks' reported three dead data-ui hooks (native-folder-picker, window-control, window-controls) styled but unused in markup.
Prettier --check initially failed on apps/app/src/styles/shell-parts/session-tree.css; fixed via --write.
tsc failed in @gizmo/agent-server because pi-agent-service.eviction.test.ts's fakeSession object lacked the now-required navigateTree property (TypeScript error TS2322).
